coords: normalised 0-1, origin top-left of the frame
note: explode.frames[j].anchors are the 2D anchor points of each labelled part in explode frame j; labels are meant to be shown on the last (fully exploded) frame. rotate anchors are informational (visible=false means occluded at that angle).

parts.name: 120mm Fan
parts.description: A 120 mm fan that pulls cool air in through the grille and pushes it across the components and out the rear vent.

parts.name: Fan Grille
parts.description: The slotted steel guard over the fan, part of the removable cover. It keeps fingers and cables out of the blades.

parts.name: Steel Housing
parts.description: The black powder-coated steel box that encloses and shields the electronics and mounts to the PC case.

parts.name: AC Inlet & Power Switch
parts.description: Where the wall power cable plugs in, next to the rocker switch that turns the power supply fully on or off.

parts.name: Rear Honeycomb Vent
parts.description: A hexagonal mesh in the rear wall that lets the warm air out of the case while keeping the housing rigid.

parts.name: Internal PCB & Capacitors
parts.description: The circuit board that converts mains AC into the low DC voltages a PC uses, with large bulk capacitors that smooth the supply.

parts.name: Heatsinks
parts.description: Finned aluminium bars that the power transistors and diodes are bolted to, so their heat spreads into the airflow.

parts.name: Cable Bundle
parts.description: The fixed (non-modular) bundle of power leads for the motherboard, CPU, graphics card and drives.
